title: Applied AI Architect, Large Enterprise
description:
About the Team

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

This role is based in our London office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.

 - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.

 - Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.

 - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

 - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

 - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.

 - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.

 - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

 - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

 - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

 - Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

 - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

 - Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.

 - Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.

 - Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.

 - Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.

 - Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.

 - Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

 - Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.

 - Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.

 - Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.

 - Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: WordPress Theme & Plugin Developer
description:
About the Role
We're seeking a talented Fullstack WordPress Developer with strong expertise in custom theme and plugin development. You'll work on WordPress projects, including theme and plugin development, and potentially some Joomla projects (with appropriate support, depending on your familiarity).
This is a contract role for full-time work over a 5 month contract.
However, you'll work as if you were a full-time employee, participating in team meetings, communicating via Slack, and coordinating with other people on our team.
Key Responsibilities
• Build custom WordPress themes that closely match designs with meticulous attention to detail
• Develop custom WordPress plugins with clean, well-structured code
• Take ownership of WordPress projects from concept to completion
• Refactor and update existing themes and templates
• Address other occasional full-stack developer tasks as needed for non-WordPress systems and situations (e.g. newsletter development)
• Provide limited support for clients who have issues or problems (secondary responsibility)
Work Hours & Meetings
You must be available to participate in meetings between 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Los Angeles time (UTC-8)
Your work hours will be negotiable. However, this is a full-time position, and the condition of this contract work is that you only work on our projects and on a full-time basis. Preference will be given to candidates that can closely align with our US timezone schedule.
You have:
• At least 4 years of experience building custom WordPress themes and plugins
• Strong front-end development skills with an eye for detail
• Deep understanding of code organization, patterns, and OOP
• Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
• The ability to work independently and complete objectives without explicit direction
• The ability to deliver polished work, self-review, and catch bugs before others do. This means that for any front-end development you do, it should be near pixel-perfect in alignment with the design you're working from.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
## This Is Us
Ingenious Lion is a Digital Tech Hub designed exclusively for Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading marketing agencies.
As the marketing industry continues to drive digital transformation, Publicis Groupe empowers its clients with innovative data solutions and media ecosystems. Ingenious Lion has one mission: to partner with Publicis’ global teams in creating innovative data and digital tech products that will shape the future.
What makes us successful? Two key ingredients: we seek the good and the best, meaning we cultivate a thriving company culture. We’re all about creating an environment where people don’t just work; they grow, challenge themselves, strive for excellence, and are recognized for their incredible value to the team.
If you’re curious to learn more about us, here are four things you should know:
Our company culture is anchored in five powerful values: Joy, Honesty, Connectivity, Own Challenger, and Greater World. Do these values resonate with you?
We are committed to diversity and inclusion because we believe our unique differences make us stronger.
We encourage open communication and create an environment where everyone’s voice is heard and every contribution is valued.
Finally, we’re somewhat “obsessed” with quality. We believe in continuous learning and knowledge sharing; when we hit a roadblock, we don’t just complain, we create solutions to overcome it.
In one sentence, we are a group of people with an unusual aptitude for generating great ideas, groundbreaking concepts, and infusing them with positive energy and good fun.
## Feeling Ingenious already?
## A Sneak Peek at Your Future Role
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll join an AI Solutions & Engineering team at Publicis Media serving the DACH region. You'll build AI agents and automations that make our media teams' work faster and smarter.
This role is about more than building agents. Our core business is media, so you'll start by getting to know how our teams work, how a media plan comes together, and where the real pain points are. You'll sit with the teams, join client calls, and turn our list of use cases into working solutions.
You'll report directly to the Expert Director Solution Engineering, and work mostly with client-facing teams, as well as marketing and product management.
Here Are the Key Tasks You'll Be Working on Every Day
Build AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio that automate and improve how our media teams work.
Create Power Apps and Power Automate flows that support these agents and wider business processes.
Learn how our agency works, from media planning to client delivery, by spending time with the teams who do it.
Review and prioritize our use-case list with stakeholders, turning ideas into clearly scoped solutions.
Design solutions within our existing architecture, and propose new approaches where they add value.
Integrate solutions with other systems through connectors and REST APIs.
Support and improve solutions after go-live, using feedback from the people who rely on them.
Collaborate with client-facing teams, marketing, and product management to understand their needs.
Proactively share ideas and drive them forward, from first concept to working solution.
Support the discovery of new use cases with teams in Austria and Switzerland.
We're Thrilled to Have You Consider Joining Our Team. Here Are the Qualifications We're Seeking
At least 3 years of experience building business solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.
Hands-on experience building agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, ideally with solutions running in production.
Solid experience with Power Apps and Power Automate.
Good understanding of the Microsoft ecosystem and how its tools work together.
Experience integrating solutions with other systems through connectors or REST APIs.
Proven ability to understand business processes and turn them into practical, user-friendly solutions.
A proactive, self-motivated approach, with a habit of sharing ideas and driving them forward.
Curiosity and a strong willingness to learn, especially about the media and advertising industry.
Clear communication with non-technical colleagues and stakeholders.
Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
## Skills That Would Make You Shine Even Brighter!
Microsoft certifications such as AB-620 (AI Agent Builder Associate), PL-400 (Power Platform Developer Associate), or AB-100 (Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect).
## German language skills.
Experience in a media, advertising, or agency environment.
Experience working with stakeholders across different countries.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
## About Wurl, LLC.
At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue.
In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.
## The Opportunity
Wurl delivers thousands of FAST channels to more than 50 streaming platforms worldwide with ads inserted in real time. We build the playout platform behind those channels, handling live events, ad signaling, and SSAI integration. Wurl is seeking a Software Engineer I to tackle engineering challenges on systems operating at scale.
## What you’ll do
Build the systems that put channels on air. Develop features in our playout platform, the software that assembles content and ad breaks into continuous linear streams.
Investigate across the stack. When viewership or ad impressions drop on a channel, use metrics and logs to trace the issue through playout, ad insertion, and CDN to its root cause.
Build tools people rely on daily. Write the Python services and automation that operations and engineering use to run channels.
Work AI-native. Use AI tools to build faster and learn faster, and hold their output to the same standard as your own code.
Own what you ship. Your work goes to production and you stand behind it, including shifts in the on-call rotation.
## What you bring
• 2+ years writing production Python: tested, maintainable code that other people rely on.
• Solid grounding in REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, and Git.
• Experience taking a well-scoped problem, working out the approach, and delivering it without step-by-step guidance.
• Experience diagnosing issues in systems you didn’t build.
• Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates.
## What you’ll learn at Wurl
Streaming: how linear playout systems are built, plus HLS, transcoding, live event switching and recordings.
Ad tech: server-side ad insertion and CTV monetization.
Cloud: AWS, serverless, and cloud-native application development.
Production engineering: monitoring, reliability, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation at scale.
## What We Offer:
• Competitive Salary, Equity (ESPP) and Bonus
• Strong Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits, 100% paid by Wurl
• Remote first policy
• Flexible, unlimited Time Off
• 10 US Holidays
• 401(k) Matching and Roth options
• Pre-Tax Savings Plans, HSA & FSA
• Various subscriptions for mental and physical wellness
• OneMedical subscription for 24/7 convenient medical care
• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave for all family additions
• $1k Work From Home Stipend to set up your Office
Few companies allow you to thrive like you will at Wurl. Join us to revolutionize the way the world watches television while enjoying mentorship, collaboration, and innovation.
We encourage all applicants, even those who don’t meet 100% of the requirements, to apply. Passion and potential go a long way here at Wurl.

title: AI Search and SEO Specialist
description:
ScrapingBee is a developer-first web scraping API that turns a hard technical problem into a simple request. It's built for developers and small teams who want reliable data without becoming scraping experts themselves.
The team behind it stays curious and fast-moving, and its small size means every person's work reaches a global developer community directly.
The SEO team owns one of the core customer acquisition channels for ScrapingBee, driving visibility and organic growth for a product loved by developers globally. As an AI Search and SEO Specialist, you will help develop and execute a dual strategy to boost traditional search visibility and drive our presence in AI-generated responses. With a heavy focus on AI search we are actively evolving our approach to ensure our content is perfectly positioned for large language models. Sounds about right? Let's talk!
## In this role, you will:
• Develop and execute the AI Search and SEO strategy, tracking keyword rankings, citation rates, mention frequencies, and sentiment across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and AI Overviews.
• Conduct keyword and prompt research to prioritize growth opportunities, preparing briefs and guiding our content creators to ensure every new piece is built to be cited and ranked.
• Build and maintain an AI visibility measurement framework, regularly analyzing metrics and reporting on when and why our visibility shifts in LLMs.
• Work closely with external SEO agencies to implement high-quality backlink building strategies, reviewing URLs, checking SEO metrics, and providing direct feedback.
• Audit and evolve our content architecture and technical SEO health, collaborating with the web and engineering teams to ensure the site’s foundation supports machine discovery.
• Own the execution of your strategies by making adjustments directly (e.g., updating landing pages) and coordinating smooth handoffs between content and web teams.
• Stay on top of industry trends and artificial intelligence optimisation opportunities.
## Your skills & experiences:
• Minimum of 3 years of on-site SEO experience with a proven track record of measurable, data-driven growth in customer acquisition.
• Hands-on exposure to GEO/AI search, coupled with a solid understanding of how large language models consume and act on web content.
• Expertise across technical and off-page SEO strategies, with the resilience to navigate unpredictable search variables and algorithm updates creatively.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to take full ownership of results and communicate complex technical information in simple terms.
• A proactive, problem-solving attitude, genuine curiosity to learn what's next in AI search, and a great sense of humor to fit right into our culture.
• Fluency in English (written and verbal).
## Nice to have:
• Experience in SEO for high-traffic global products.
• Hands-on experience with prompt engineering or LLM evaluation.
• Familiarity with agentic AI workflows.
• Previous experience working in-house.
Don't meet everything above? Apply anyway. We're looking for what's next, not what's already been done.
## Tech stack:
AI visibility tools: Profound, Peec AI, AI Clicks, TrendOS, or similar
SEO tools: Ahrefs, Google Search Console (GSC), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Screaming Frog (must-haves), Surfer SEO, SEMRush
Business Intelligence tools: PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker
## Salary & Benefits:
Gross salary: 3000 - 4400 EUR/month. Keep in mind that we are open to discuss a different salary based on your skills and competencies.
Growth & Learning: 40+ internal learning options, external conferences, mentorship, and year-round knowledge-sharing.
Celebration & Community: Team events, an overseas workation, quarterly team-building budgets, and plenty of ways to mark milestones together.
• Plus bonus vacation days, paid life-moment days off, barista coffee, and all the tools you need. See the full list of benefits here:
ScrapingBee is part of Source, a data ecosystem for a world built on intelligence. One of a growing network of independent technology companies connected by shared standards, expertise, and a belief in responsible access to web data.

title: Data Engineer III
description:
What are important things that YOU need to know about this role?
Experience: Advanced SQL coding skills and strong dbt (Data Build Tool) development experience are required. This includes developing complex data models, creating and maintaining transformation pipelines, and troubleshooting data quality and performance issues.
Work Location: This position offers permanent remote work.
What will YOU be doing for us?Independently design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain modern data warehouse solutions that transform replicated SKYGEN Enterprise System application data into trusted, reusable data products for analytics and reporting. This role uses Snowflake and dbt to build scalable dimensional models, apply data-quality controls, analyze complex source-system data and relationships, and maintain clear business and technical lineage across SKYGEN’s enterprise data environment supporting more than 160 client databases.
## What will YOU be working on every day?
Data Warehouse Design & Dimensional Modeling: Independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain dimensional data warehouse objects, including fact, dimension, bridge, and reference tables, using approved Kimball and relational modeling standards. Define grain, business and surrogate keys, historical tracking, slowly changing dimensions, effective dating, and referential relationships for assigned subject areas.
dbt Data Development: Develop modular, reusable, documented, and testable dbt models that transform replicated source data through standardized staging, integration, dimensional, and publication layers. Use appropriate dbt sources, references, tests, macros, snapshots, and incremental processing patterns.
Landed Data Usage: Use replicated and ingested source data made available in Snowflake to build downstream transformation and publication layers. Validate the completeness, availability, and usability of source data without owning ingestion-platform infrastructure.
Enterprise Data Analysis: Analyze complex SKYGEN Enterprise System application schemas to identify authoritative data elements, keys, relationships, business rules, and historical behavior required to support defined reporting, analytics, and data-product use cases.

Software Development Lifecycle: Apply software engineering practices to data development, including Git-based source control, peer review, branching and pull-request workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, release validation, deployment documentation, and rollback planning.
Monitor & Support Solutions: Monitor data transformations and published data products, investigate failures and discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, implement sustainable corrections, and communicate status and technical findings to internal and external stakeholders.
Collaboration: Work with data integration, analytics, reporting, quality assurance, platform, security, and business teams to translate approved requirements into reliable production data solutions.

Two or more years of experience developing production solutions using a modern cloud data warehouse and transformation framework, preferably Snowflake and dbt.

title: DevOps / Platform Engineer | Tundr
description:
🌍 Modalità di lavoro:Full remote (ufficio disponibile a Milano per chi preferisce lavorare in presenza)
💻 Key tech skills:AWS (serverless), Infrastructure as Code (CDK), CI/CD con GitHub Actions, Observability e monitoring
⏳ Esperienza:7-8 anni
💰 RAL:50-65k€ + stock option plan
Tundr sta riscrivendo le regole del welfare aziendale in Italia da fintech: tutto il welfare di un'azienda su un'unica carta, la Tundr Card, per rendere semplici e scalabili sia i fringe benefit che i flexible benefit, oggi spesso vissuti dalle aziende come un adempimento burocratico. In due anni Tundr ha acquisito oltre 1.500 clienti, si è posizionata all'11° posto della classifica Sifted 100 Southern Europe 2026 (le startup a crescita più rapida del Sud Europa) e ha appena annunciato un round serie A da 11 milioni di euro.
L'infrastruttura di Tundr gira interamente su AWS, con un'architettura fortemente serverless oriented, progettata e cresciuta in casa fin dall'inizio.
Oggi l'azienda cerca la seconda persona da affiancare a chi ha costruito tutta questa parte, per condividerne la responsabilità. La persona entrerà nel team Platform, che si occupa dell'architettura dell'intero prodotto insieme agli sviluppatori backend.
## Cosa farai:
Garantirai che tutti i servizi su AWS siano up and running, gestendo l'infrastruttura in ottica Infrastructure as Code con CDK
Gestirai e farai evolvere le pipeline di CI/CD su GitHub Actions, che deployano su AWS.
Supporterai quotidianamente gli sviluppatori sui feature environment, repliche dell'intera architettura AWS su cui il team testa le nuove funzionalità prima della produzione
Imposterai da zero il sistema di observability e monitoring: metriche, SLI e SLO adatti al caso d'uso di Tundr, dashboard e alert, insieme agli standard che permetteranno agli sviluppatori di monitorare in autonomia le proprie feature
Contribuirai alle scelte architetturali su AWS quando c'è da progettare qualcosa di nuovo: quali servizi usare, come configurarli, come farli parlare tra loro
Lavorerai a stretto contatto con gli sviluppatori per la gestione di tutto il sistema event-driven di Tundr.
## Requisiti tecnici:
7-8 anni di esperienza, di cui una parte significativa in un ruolo DevOps, SRE o Platform Engineering su un prodotto in produzione
Buona conoscenza di AWS e dei suoi servizi managed
Esperienza con Infrastructure as Code (CDK o strumenti analoghi come Terraform)
Esperienza nella gestione di pipeline CI/CD
Esperienza concreta su observability e monitoring (metriche, alerting, dashboard, SLI/SLO), meglio se in un progetto in cui hai contribuito in prima persona a impostare il sistema
Ottime capacità di comunicazione: saper spiegare concetti complessi in modo semplice, anche a persone non tecniche
## Buona padronanza della lingua italiana
Non serve spuntare ogni voce al 100%: il perimetro del ruolo è ampio e Tundr è disposta a valutare anche chi è un po' meno forte su una delle aree (ad esempio AWS o GitHub Actions) se porta un'esperienza significativa sull'observability, purché abbia voglia di imparare il resto.
## Nice to have:
Esperienza con architetture serverless su AWS: Lambda, ECS su Fargate, DynamoDB, Aurora, API Gateway, SQS, Cognito
## Esperienza con GitHub Actions
Esperienza con strumenti di observability come Prometheus, Grafana o simili
Conoscenza di Go (l'azienda ha una CLI interna in Go a supporto degli sviluppatori)
Esperienza in contesti startup o scale-up, su un prodotto consolidato con molti clienti e dati da gestire
Interesse verso contesti fintech o pagamenti
## Sei la persona ideale se:
Ti piace lavorare in autonomia: in Tundr non ricevi una soluzione già pronta da eseguire, ma una serie di problemi da mettere in priorità e risolvere, trovando tu la strada migliore.
Hai voglia di costruire qualcosa da zero, come il sistema di observability, e di portare le tue idee nelle scelte architetturali.
Pur essendo un ruolo da individual contributor, lavori a stretto contatto con gli altri: sei la persona a cui gli sviluppatori si rivolgono quando qualcosa non funziona negli environment o quando una nuova feature richiede di introdurre nuovi servizi AWS, quindi ti piace collaborare, ti fai sentire spesso e sai spiegare le cose con chiarezza a chiunque.
Ti trovi bene in un contesto da remoto che valorizza molto il confronto diretto e sincrono con il team.
## Cosa offre l'azienda:
## Contratto di assunzione, CCNL Commercio
## RAL 50-65k€ + stock option plan
## Bonus su obiettivi aziendali
## Corposo piano di welfare aziendale
## Buoni pasto (in arrivo da gennaio 2027)
Modalità di lavoro full remote, con ufficio a Milano sempre disponibile per chi lo desidera
Offsite periodici per allinearsi, confrontarsi e stare insieme
Un problema reale da risolvere, in un team che cresce e insegna, con autonomia vera e impatto misurabile
## Processo di selezione:
## 2 step Welyk: recruiter + tech mentor
## 1 step tecnico con il team Tundr
Breve chiacchierata conoscitiva finale con l'HR
L'annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto del D.lgs. 198/2006 e s.m.i., e a persone di ogni età, nazionalità, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere e appartenenza etnica, nel rispetto dei principi di non discriminazione e pari opportunità.

title: AI Trainer
description:
About Metis Strategy
Metis Strategy, a management and strategy consulting firm, focused on the intersection of business and technology, continues to grow and is looking for highly motivated individuals to join our San Francisco Bay Area team. We are trusted advisors to Fortune 500 and Global 1000 companies, helping them meet their most critical business objectives through tailored engagements and deep professional relationships. We work across industries on topics related to business & digital strategy and navigating organizational change.
We are an entrepreneurial, fast-growing firm headquartered in the Washington, D.C. area with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas, Texas. The firm’s presence from coast to coast allows us to serve clients throughout the United States and internationally. In our 20+ year history, we have established a track record of making lasting impacts on organizational performance and helping executives improve business outcomes. In a career with Metis Strategy you will experience high growth as you encounter new challenges with each client engagement; have a high degree of autonomy to craft the direction of your work; and become empowered to work directly with thought-leaders, C-level clients, and other decision-makers.
## What We Look For
## Role summary
You will design and deliver hands-on AI training for enterprise clients. Sessions are mostly virtual and run in 3–4 hour blocks across global time zones. Audiences range from executives to software engineers. Builder cohorts work in the labs themselves: skills, agents, MCP servers, coding agents, code review. Leader and enabler cohorts work on everyday workflows. You co-facilitate with other Metis trainers and tailor the content to each client’s industry, tools and security requirements. You own keeping content current. Models, tools and pricing change quarterly, so you update materials before each cohort.
## Must-have
## Technical depth
• You have shipped LLM or agentic systems to production, not just prototyped them. You can show examples.
• You are fluent in how agentic coding harnesses work: context files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md), skills, subagents, hooks, MCP and plugins. You have built a custom MCP server and an agent end to end.
• You know the main ways to extend a model (prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, self-hosting) and can explain when to use each.
• You understand agent security: prompt injection, least-privilege tools, human-in-the-loop and guardrails outside the model.
• You can explain Tokenomics and cost control to both engineers and finance audiences.
Ecosystem breadth
• Hands-on with Anthropic (Claude, Claude Code, Cowork), OpenAI (ChatGPT, Codex, SDKs), Microsoft (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, GitHub Copilot) and open-weight models.
• Working familiarity with Google (Gemini, Vertex), AWS (Bedrock), Cursor and the major agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, MS Agent Framework).
Teaching and facilitation
• You have taught live, technical, hands-on sessions to groups, in person or virtual.
• You pace a 4-hour virtual session well: polls, breakouts, chat, energy management and a clean break structure.
• You troubleshoot setup problems in locked-down enterprise environments (Windows, WSL2, proxies, restricted installs, SSO and licensing) without losing the room.
• You can explain complex concepts plainly to different audiences, and you stay calm when a live demo misbehaves. Models are non-deterministic, so demos will sometimes fail.
People skills (observable)
• You read a remote room and adjust. You can tell who is lost, who is bored and who is already ahead.
• You handle skepticism and job-displacement anxiety directly, without dismissing it.
• You are comfortable saying “I don’t know, let’s test it.”
Experience
• 10+ years in software development, data/ML engineering, architecture or technical product work, with recent, practical experience building with LLMs.
## Strong plus
• Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including working under a partner brand and co-facilitating.
• Governance and compliance fluency: responsible AI, data classification, and regional requirements such as the EU AI Act and data residency.
• Evals and observability experience: building test sets, guardrails and monitoring for LLM applications.
• Instructional design: building labs, measuring learning with pre/post assessments, and reinforcing it afterward (office hours, 30/60/90-day follow-through).
• Change management or AI adoption experience, including connecting training to business outcomes and ROI.
• Domain experience in a regulated or industrial sector (manufacturing, IT/OT, healthcare, financial services).
• Experience authoring skills, plugins or reusable templates that a client team can maintain.
## Nice to have
• Experience teaching across cultures and non-native English audiences (for example India, EMEA and North America in the same program).
• Public thought leadership: writing, talks or open-source work.
• Self-hosted inference and fine-tuning experience (vLLM, Ollama, LoRA/QLoRA).
## What Metis Strategy Has to Offer
Successful candidates will be motivated by the desire to make a difference by helping our clients achieve and maintain strategic and operational excellence while continuously improving their own skill set and embracing emerging intellectual challenges.
This position is also eligible for bonus compensation. Additional benefits include but are not limited to:
• comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance;
• parental leave, and family benefits;
• retirement contributions;
• stipend for continued learning;
• paid time off, and more.
Compensation and benefits are competitive and will be commensurate with each candidate’s qualifications and relevant work experience.
If you are driven by the desire to help some of the world’s most renowned companies solve complex business problems and excited by the intersection of business strategy and technological innovation, you will enjoy being a part of our team.

• Support the development of the protocol’s statistical sections, providing the foundation for the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).

Biostatistician/Statistical programmer Contractor for Biostatistics Team.

• Mastering the statistical theory of a broad spectrum of methodologies and experimental designs.
• Creative and innovative.
• Rigor and discipline.
• Team player, ability to share knowledge within multidisciplinary teams.
• SAS and R programming experience.
• Effective communication and presentation skills, able to liaise theory with the practical translations.

You must also have these skills
• University level in Sciences or Engineering with at least post-graduate in Biostatistics or equivalent.
• At least 3 years of experience as a Biostatistician or Statistical Programmer supporting clinical trials. Knowledge/experience on Good Clinical Laboratory practices/ Good Clinical Practices is a must.
• Experience includes supporting and/or leading statistical programming and reporting deliverables and working with SDTM and ADaM datasets is a must.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

title: NodeJS AI Engineer
description:
## Company Overview
At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.
Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.
## Position Description
We are looking for a talented and experienced Node JS AI Engineer to join our team in LATAM.
You will build the agent at the core of the intake system: the component that reads messy construction documents and returns structured project fields, each with its source, quote and confidence. You will own extraction quality end to end, from prompts and page-handling strategy to the evaluations that prove the agent is accurate enough for designers to trust. The agent reads and reports; deterministic backend code decides. Keeping that boundary clean is central to the role.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Design and build the agent that inventories project folders, locates the relevant sheets (reflected ceiling plans, sections, legends, specifications), reads text where it exists and renders page regions as images when needed.
• Implement extraction of project fields with file, page, region, exact quote and confidence, validated against a fixed output schema.
• Detect and report contradictions between emails and documents, and within a single document, without choosing a value silently.
• Handle large packages (up to 1,500 pages), scanned PDFs and non-scale drawings, controlling cost with per-session caps and re-reading only changed files.
• Write and iterate prompts and tool definitions (for example sync_drive) and configure the agent platform, Managed Agents or Deep Agents with a sandbox.
• Build the evaluation harness in LangSmith: datasets from real projects, citation checks, accuracy thresholds, and model comparisons on accuracy and cost.
• Apply defenses against prompt injection from external content: no credentials in the sandbox, restricted network, links only from the thread.
• Work with the Backend Engineer on the contract between the agent and the rules engine, and with designers to turn their corrections into new evaluation cases
Workplace: Remote role open to candidates based in LATAM
## Must Have Skills:
• 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years building production LLM or agent-based systems.
• Strong TypeScript and Node.js; working knowledge of Python for document processing in sandboxes.
• Hands-on experience with LangGraph, Deep Agents, the Anthropic SDK or comparable agent frameworks, including tool use and structured outputs.
• Proven experience extracting information from unstructured or poor-quality documents (scans, drawings, PDFs with inconsistent structure), including vision-based reading.
• Experience designing evaluations for LLM systems: datasets, metrics, regression checks, and measuring hallucination or unsupported answers.
• Solid understanding of prompt injection risks and of agent safety design.
• Ability to explain model limitations plainly to non-technical stakeholders
## Preferred Skills:
• Experience with construction, architectural, engineering or other drawing-heavy documents.
• Experience with PDF and OCR tooling, and with Gmail and Google Drive APIs.
• Experience with LangSmith, Claude Managed Agents, or sandbox platforms such as Daytona.
• Experience building human-in-the-loop review workflows and deciding when automation can act without review
## Professional Skills:
• Strong, professional English verbal and written communication skills
• Effective team and individual player
• Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature
• High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results
• Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention
• Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues
Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Ready to participate in building and evolving our next-generation Transportation & Logistics data platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)? This role combines cloud engineering, data pipelines, and software engineering with a default focus on automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), operational resilience, and corporate governance.
## What Makes This Role Interesting:
The Data Platform Engineer – Generalist operates as an AI-augmented builder who decides, designs, and fixes across our cloud infrastructure, platform tooling, and data engineering layers.
Recognizing that no single engineer can be a deep expert across every layer of the modern data stack, this role uses AI tools by reflex to deliver end-to-end capabilities with minimal handoffs or coordination overhead. Operating in a lean Platform Engineering pod, you will bring strong core capabilities while maintaining the breadth required to support our ongoing platform migration from AWS and Azure to GCP, build data workflows, and collaborate closely with lead data engineers.
## Your Key Responsibilities:
Decide, Design, & Ship End-to-End: Own platform outcomes from intent through to production. Prefer direct iteration (think → build → validate) over cross-role handoffs, pulling in specialists only when risk or complexity truly justifies it.
Engineer Infrastructure as Code: Design, provision, configure, and evolve cloud environments using version-controlled, reusable IaC modules (Terraform) and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.
Support Multi-Cloud Migration: Assist in migrating legacy workloads, storage layers, and pipelines from AWS and Azure into our unified GCP platform.
Build Data Platform Capabilities: Support the design, deployment, and optimization of data primitives, analytics platforms, and pipeline orchestration (batch and streaming).
Embed Governance & Guardrails: Translate corporate security, privacy, compliance, and risk requirements into automated technical guardrails (IAM, network controls, secrets management, data classification, and encryption).
Maintain Auditability & Telemetry: Treat observability, technical documentation, decision records (ADRs), deployment evidence, and runbooks as core elements of the product—ensuring all services are observable and safe to operate.
Leverage AI by Reflex: Integrate AI coding assistants and LLM workflows into daily platform operations to accelerate automation, troubleshooting, documentation, and code reviews across multiple technical domains.
Cost & Capacity Stewardship: Manage cloud spend responsibly through labeling standards, capacity monitoring, cost-control policies, and lifecycle practices.
Production-Ready Delivery Standards ("Definition of Done"):
• IaC & CI/CD Managed: Infrastructure fully defined in version-controlled IaC with peer review and automated CI/CD pipeline deployment.
• Observability & Recovery: Monitoring, alerting, logging, and telemetry active prior to release, alongside defined and tested rollback paths.
• Operational Readiness: Updated runbooks for anything that could create an incident or page someone off-hours.
• Governance Compliance: Verified alignment with security, data privacy, architecture, and corporate risk controls.
## Your Essential Skills & Experience:
Engineering Generalism: Ability to read, reason about, and debug code, data pipelines, and infrastructure across multiple layers of the stack—using AI to execute beyond your primary area of expertise while critically validating output for safety and performance.
Cloud & Platform Engineering: Solid foundational knowledge of cloud primitives (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with hands-on capability or strong willingness to specialize in GCP. Hands-on experience with declarative IaC tools (e.g., Terraform), state management, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).
Data Engineering Fundamentals: Working knowledge of modern data stack primitives and tooling (e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub/Kafka, Dataflow or dbt).
AI & Operational Excellence: Uses AI tools by default to accelerate delivery and solve complex platform issues. Applies critical judgment to identify plausible-but-wrong AI outputs.
Systems Thinking & Pragmatic Judgment: Defaults to the simplest solution that satisfies operational needs. Exercises sound judgment on when to iterate independently vs. when to escalate critical security, privacy, or long-term architecture decisions.
• The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, self-directed builder who views testing, IaC, observability, documentation, and governance as part of the core product rather than administrative overhead. They combine broad technical curiosity with operational discipline, leveraging modern AI workflows to bridge domain gaps, eliminate delivery friction, and keep platform services resilient and cost-effective.
## About Us:
Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.

From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

Essential
8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience.
Strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash, and Python.

The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. Define measurable, statistically rigorous concepts of data quality, including coverage, label quality, uncertainty, provenance and model performance.

Statistical methods for distinguishing genuine data-quality problems from label ambiguity, inconsistent annotation or evaluation noise.
Labeler and dataset metrics that support training-data selection, simulation, annotation acceptance and model evaluation.
Reusable quality artefacts that replace one-off analyses with registered, automated metrics and reports.

Quality standards spanning coverage, uncertainty, provenance, annotation quality and predictive-model performance.
Integration of data-science outputs into the platform workflows used by engineering and research teams

title: Data & AI Engineer (Frankfurt or Munich, Germany)
description:
## Who We Are
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a leading Data & AI services company helping large organisations turn data and AI into measurable business value. We work with major enterprises across industries including pharma, chemicals, manufacturing, financial services and automotive, solving complex problems across operations, R&D, customer experience and core business processes. Today, Unit8 brings together 170+ engineers, data scientists and consultants across Europe and North America, with a growing presence in the Middle East. We have delivered more than 350 Data & AI projects, spanning GenAI and AI engineering, data platforms, cloud, machine learning and advanced analytics.
## Our Mission
Our mission is to help organisations make Data & AI work in the real world. We combine strong engineering, technical expertise and business understanding to take ideas from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment and adoption.
Requirements
## About You
As a Data & AI engineer, you build the technical side of client projects, going from a business problem to a solution running in production. You help work out what the client actually needs, design the parts you own and write most of the code yourself. You work in a small project team with a technical lead, and you talk directly with the client's engineers and users.
This role is for engineers who want to own real pieces of client work end to end and grow their impact, while staying hands-on.
## What You’ll Do
• Build the solution: design and write tested, maintainable production code for GenAI applications (agents, RAG, LLM apps) or data platforms and pipelines, and get it running for real users.
• Own your part: take responsibility for a component or workstream, from design to deployment, and deliver it with limited supervision.
• Work with the client: understand their business problem, help turn it into clear requirements, and explain your technical choices and trade-offs to stakeholders.
• Own the quality: be accountable for what you ship, backed by testing, documentation and code reviews with your team.
• Learn and share: grow quickly alongside senior engineers, and share what you learn with the rest of the team.
## Why You'll Love It
• Solve problems that matter: work directly with clients on complex challenges where Data & AI materially improves how their business runs.
• Build, not just advise: you ship code that runs for real users, not slide decks.
• Work at the edge of Data & AI: GenAI and agents, AI engineering, modern data platforms.
• Work with people who raise the bar: deeply technical engineers and data scientists who care about solving hard problems and will help you grow.
• Grow with us: take on more ownership, more complex projects and, if you want it, a path towards technical leadership as you prove yourself.
## Who You Are
• 2 to 4 years of experience building software, data or AI systems, and you are hands-on: you have written production code in Python in the last 3 months.
• Solid experience in GenAI / AI Engineering or ML / Data Science that you have helped take to production.
• Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD and clean, readable code.
• Good at problem decomposition and software design: you can turn requirements into a well-structured solution and explain the trade-offs.
• You have owned technical work end to end: a feature, a component or a pipeline you were responsible for.
• You learn fast and look for feedback: you want to improve your code and your craft.
• You enjoy working with clients and can explain technical choices clearly. Experience in consulting or another client-facing environment is a plus.
• Experience with Data Platforms & Cloud (Azure, AWS) is a plus.
How We Hire
Our hiring process includes a live coding interview without AI assistance, a technical design discussion and a client case study.
Benefits
What we offer
• Work on client projects that have a concrete impact on their business.
• Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different
• Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts) or building our own MLOps platform.
• Tailor-made mentorship programme.
• Learning activities such as ML and Engineering Knowledge Sharing Groups.
• Up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
• Opportunity to join a fast-growing service company with a start-up atmosphere.
• Work with an international team made of more than 15 nationalities.
• Cross offices/company-wide frequent events (off-site or on-line).
• Fun Fund to spend with the team on after-work activities.
• Compensation package including base salary and profit sharing based on the performance of the company
• Extended parental leave conditions.
## Why Unit8?
At Unit8, we don’t just turn data into value – we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here.
• Trust from Day One: We rely on your expertise. Trust is the core of our culture.
• Meaningful Work: You drive things that matter and make others' projects easier through your work.
• Passion-Led Projects: We provide the environment where you can pursue your passion alongside top talent. If you are excited about the future, you belong with us.

title: Cloud Architect (m/w/d)
description:
## Wir sind Royal Runtimes. Wir bauen AI-Systeme, bevor andere darüber Folien machen.
Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen.
Eines dieser Ventures ist eine PaaS für Builder Companies auf Google Cloud: eine Plattform, auf der Unternehmen ihre eigene Software mit AI bauen und betreiben. Für ihre Architektur suchen wir jemanden, der Google Cloud besser kennt als wir beide zusammen.
## Mit wem du arbeitest
Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet.
Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah.
Du gehörst zu unseren ersten Einstellungen und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den neuen Skill, der unsere CI/CD 100x besser macht.
## Was du bei uns machst
• Du sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere AI-PaaS auf Hunderte Enterprise-Kunden skalieren und betreiben können.
• Du steuerst Agents. Die Guidelines und die Governance, nach denen sie Terraform, Pipelines und Code bauen, entwickelst du selbst. So skalieren wir unsere Software Factory.
• Wir treffen die technischen Grundsatzentscheidungen der Plattform gemeinsam, unter deiner Führung.
• Du arbeitest am Produkt. In Beratungsprojekte holen wir dich für Strategiefragen oder wenn ein Team nicht weiterkommt.
## Was du mitbringst
• Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung mit Google Cloud. Du hast dort Plattformen entworfen, gebaut und in Produktion betrieben.
• Du bist die Person, die gefragt wird, wenn bei Google Cloud sonst niemand weiterweiß.
• Du könntest jede Ressource selbst in Terraform schreiben. Du lässt das Agenten machen und bist das Mastermind hinter deiner Agent Fleet.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Synthetic Data
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
Here’s what this particular role covers.
🛠️ About our Simulation Teams
Simulation is advancing end-to-end autonomous driving research. The team’s mission is to accelerate AV2.0 by incubating capabilities that become company-level advantages — generative world models and the synthetic data they produce are one of those. The goal of this role is to build, scale, and optimise next-generation world model architectures (GAIA and successors) and bridge them into high-throughput generation and training infrastructure, so synthetic data can dramatically accelerate autonomy development. You will post-train world models for new embodiments and behaviours (rig transfer, pose transfer, dashcam restaging), generate multimodal synthetic experience at scale, and land that data in the same training stack we use for real driving. You sit between ML research and engineering: collaborating with scientists on architecture and conditioning, and with platform engineers on generation jobs, training artefacts, and how synthetic data is mixed into training. Your work will decide how fast we can train, evaluate, and deploy driving models on vehicles we have barely collected from.
🧠 Your day-to-day
Model development: Post-train, distill, and evaluate GAIA-family large video diffusion models to improve generation quality, controllability, and generalisation. Run ablation studies and investigate failures in visual quality, temporal consistency, motion, and action conditioning.
Generation at scale: Build and run synthetic video generation pipelines across tens of thousands of driving segments. Optimise inference efficiency, manage GPU resources, and ensure data quality throughout the pipeline.
From generation to training: Integrate synthetic data across different stages of driving-model training, develop sampling strategies, and measure its impact through evaluation suites and on-road performance.
Cross-team collaboration: Work with driving-model teams to determine effective data mixtures and with simulation and evaluation teams to turn generated scenarios into useful closed-loop tests.
Applied research: Translate advances in world modelling, video generation, flow matching, distillation, and data-centric training into measurable improvements in the models and data we deploy.
🧩 What you’ll be working on
Post-train and iterate GAIA-class world models for synthetic-data capabilities: embodiment transfer (new camera/vehicle embodiments), pose transfer (rewritten ego trajectories), and related conditioning (geometry, calibration, actions).
Own the generation loop: config → large-scale GPU inference → training-ready artefacts, with clear lineage from the model and settings that produced them.
Land synthetic data in driving-model training (behaviour cloning, reward models, RL): binarisation, mix ratios, quality filters, and experiments that measure suite and on-road impact — including when synthetic should replace scarce real rig data.Diagnose and fix geometry, artefacts, calibration, and controllability failures that determine whether generated video is training-grade.
Improve throughput and yield: inference optimisations (distillation, KV cache), valid-generation rate, and self-serve workflows so model developers can request synthetic sets without a specialist.
Expand coverage to new vehicle platforms and safety-critical scenarios (OEM bring-up; Emergency Lane Keeping / Automatic Emergency Braking).
Partner with world-model researchers, infra, and driving-model owners so generation, evaluation, and training stay one system.
🙌 You should apply if
4+ years in applied ML / research engineering, with a track record of training and shipping neural nets, not only operating data platforms.
Strong Python and PyTorch (or equivalent); comfort with GPU training, debugging, and reading model code.
Hands-on experience with video, generative, or world models (diffusion / flow-matching / autoregressive video, novel-view synthesis, neural rendering, or similar).
Working knowledge of cameras and 3D geometry (multi-camera rigs, intrinsics/extrinsics, warps/reprojection) and why they break generation or downstream training.
Evidence of taking generated or simulated data into a trained downstream model and measuring impact (mix, ablations, failure analysis).
Ability to operate generation or training at real scale (multi-GPU jobs, workflow orchestration, large video artefacts) and to make that path reliable.
Collaborative, experimental working style with researchers and platform engineers; you will own a capability, not a ticket queue.
🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
More about Wayve:
🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:
Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
🔍 The Interview Process:
Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)
Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1.5 hours total)
Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)
Final interview: Mission & values alignment (45 mins).
We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
What’s in it for you (Location dependant):
💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
A quick, honest note before you apply.
Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve
DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams
Generative Simulation is the team advancing our end-to-end autonomous driving research, incubating and investing in new ideas that can become game-changing technological advances for Wayve. As a Machine Learning Engineer in the team, you will play a key role in developing next-generation world models and planners, such as GAIA, that can simulate complex, diverse, and temporally consistent driving environments to power faster training, broader testing, and scalable deployment, even in areas and scenarios we have never driven in before. As we push toward the next generation of GAIA, efficiency and interactivity are a major focus: models must run thousands of roll-outs per second, support closed-loop agent interaction, and fit within practical compute budgets. You will work at the intersection of machine learning research, multi-modal modelling, and real-world deployment, tackling questions such as how we can deploy autonomous vehicles in a new geography without collecting any real-world data, and whether synthetically generated environments can fully replace physical testing and data collection.
🧠 Your day-to-day
Setting technical direction: Set technical direction and designing key components of the system.
Deep work / coding: You spend a focused block implementing and debugging new modeling capabilities.
Cross-team collaboration, brainstorming and pairing: you brainstorm ideas with your team mates or pair to solve a difficult problem
Mentorship / async review: You review a teammate’s pull request or experimental design and outcomes and provide feedback
Sync-ups: Share findings with the rest of your team leading to a discussion on designing the next experiments. You align on shared priorities for the week and blockers.
Paper reading/ reading groups: Read one of the latest papers and summarise them for yourself or the team to present in the next reading group if interesting
🧩 What you’ll be working on
Invent next-generation, efficient generative world-models (diffusion, transformer or hybrid) that deliver real-time roll-outs and controllable scene editing.
Architect interactive world models where agents (or humans) can step the model, enabling reinforcement learning, planning and safety evaluation loops.
Optimise end-to-end performance – from latent compression to context pruning – your aim is to reduce inference latency by orders of magnitude.
Define robust metrics for long-horizon coherence, physics fidelity and planner integration; run ablations and scaling studies to understand trade-offs.
Ship impact: integrate your models into closed-loop training and evaluation, and measure the sim-to-real gap against on-road driving-model results.
Mentor and influence: guide junior researchers, shape technical road-maps, publish at top venues and represent Wayve in the community.
Challenge assumptions and drive innovation: propose bold ideas, conduct ablation studies, and question conventional approaches to training and evaluation.
🙌 You should apply if
4+ years of experience in ML research/engineering with a focus on generative video, world models.
Deep knowledge in diffusion & latent-video models; track record of improving sampling efficiency or model throughput.
Experience working with high-dimensional temporal or spatial-temporal data (e.g., video, multi-sensor fusion).
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering fundamentals, and experience building research-grade production tools.
Strong publication record or contributions to open-source ML tooling.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, innovative, interdisciplinary team environment.
🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

## Build the software behind large-scale battery storage
Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.
But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.
## About GIGA Storage
Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.
We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.
## Your role
You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism.
What will you work on? When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead.
## What will you do?
Build software. Develop and maintain Python services and integrations for new battery sites.
Make data reliable. Build and improve data pipelines, quality checks and monitoring.

## What do you bring?

Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages.
Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure.
Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus.
A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge.
Good English communication skills and availability to work from our Amsterdam office at least three days a week.
Energy-sector experience and Dutch language skills are not required.
## Why join GIGA Storage?
Visible impact. Your software helps bring new battery sites into operation.
Technical variety. Combine software, data and cloud while broadening your skills.
Room to contribute. Help automate our platform and prepare it for the next stage of growth.
Build together. Join five international IT colleagues in our new Buitenveldert office, close to Amsterdam Zuid.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.
About us
All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities.
What the job looks like
Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems.
Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team.
Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source.
Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal.
Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history.
What you bring
Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told.
Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too.
Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job.
Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time.
Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge. You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards.
AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do.
Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus.
Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus.
Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.
