title: Data Engineer
description:
Digital Associate Director (Data Engineer)
Introduction to role:
Are you ready to build the data backbone of a next‑generation, digitally enabled manufacturing site? In this role, you will turn strategic priorities into scalable, data‑driven solutions that strengthen real-time decision making and operational excellence across Production, Quality, Engineering and Supply Chain. Your work will enable connected, predictive and adaptive operations that ultimately help us deliver medicines to patients with greater reliability and speed.
Reporting to the Digital Lead and working closely with multi-functional collaborators, you will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution—translating business needs into robust data architectures, pipelines and analytics applications. Can you see yourself designing trusted data foundations, powering digital twins and AI use cases, and driving measurable improvements in compliance, performance and productivity in a regulated environment?
Accountabilities:
Digital Roadmap Delivery: Partner with site and enterprise collaborators to implement the digital roadmap for Singapore Operations, aligning initiatives to business priorities, operational needs and standards to deliver measurable value.
Program and Project Delivery: Lead and coordinate digital projects and workstreams with clear scope, landmarks and risk management; drive disciplined delivery that meets business case outcomes in a GMP context.
End‑to‑End Digital Integration: Define process requirements, user needs, data flows and integration points across platforms and analytics environments to connect systems and enable multi-functional insights.
Data Architecture and Pipelines: Design, develop and maintain site‑level data architectures and scalable pipelines that support manufacturing, quality, engineering and supply chain processes, improving availability, quality and accessibility of data.
Trusted Data Foundations: Establish and sustain data standards, metadata, governance practices and documentation that underpin reliable reporting, analytics and digital product deployment; ensure data is structured for reuse, scalability and compliance.
Analytics and AI Enablement: Partner with data scientists, engineers and business teams to prepare data and implementation support for dashboards, predictive analytics, AI‑enabled solutions and operational insights that improve performance, reliability and quality.
Performance and Adoption: Track delivery progress and post‑implementation outcomes; capture lessons learned, drive user adoption, and iterate to maximise impact and sustainability.
Governance and Prioritisation: Prepare updates for governance forums, highlight risks and dependencies, and support value‑ and feasibility‑based prioritisation decisions.
Digital Capability Building: Develop digital literacy and adoption through training coordination, user engagement and practical guidance on new systems, data products and ways of working.
Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Identify and deliver improvements to processes, data flows, reporting and tools—balancing innovation with GMP compliance, maintainability and real‑world practicality.
Digital Applications for Process Optimisation: Build applications such as digital twins or AI agents that enhance organisational efficiency and unlock new ways of working.
External and Internal Networks: Engage with internal digital communities and selected external partners or suppliers to share findings, align with standards and adopt relevant protocols.
Essential Skills/Experience:
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Business, or a related field
Experience:
5+ years in digital transformation, data engineering, analytics, or related roles.
Proven track record delivering digital solutions or Industry 4.0 initiatives in manufacturing (preferably pharma/biologics)
Experience in data engineering, building and maintaining robust data foundations and delivering scalable data pipelines, integrations, and data products that enable analytics, AI, and digital twin use cases across complex enterprise environments.
Ability to lead cross-functional change in highly regulated environments
Proven track record of leading complex, high-impact data science initiatives end-to-end, delivering measurable business or operational outcomes
Technical Skills:
Knowledge of digital technologies (IoT, cloud platforms, AI/ML, data analytics, automation)
Knowledge of data architecture principles and modern data platform design to enable real-time decision-making, trusted data flows, and closed-loop control across complex enterprise environments
Leadership Skills:
Strong communicator with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across cross-functional and matrix teams
Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, supporting delivery plans, managing risks, and ensuring effective execution
Sound judgment and comfortable operating in a challenging, fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
Innovative, with strong focus and proven experience in delivering continuous improvement using digital solutions
Desirable Skills/Experience:
Formal certification in relevant discipline
Practical usage of Agile Methodology
Experience of working in a global organisation with complex/geographical context
Pharmaceutical business awareness/business domain knowledge
Cross industry business awareness/business domain knowledge
General understanding of manufacturing data systems (e.g. historian data, process monitoring platforms or integrated data environments)
Previous expertise in one or more data science domains (e.g. multivariate analysis, statistical modelling, data visualization, workflow automation), with the ability to work across domains
Experience performing data analysis, data profiling, and business-to-data translation.
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
Why AstraZeneca:
Here, your engineering will power real outcomes for patients as we scale a modern, data‑led enterprise. We bring together unexpected combinations of expertise—manufacturing, analytics, automation, AI and machine learning—to spark bold ideas and turn them into production‑grade solutions. With strong backing and established platforms, you will experiment, learn fast and deliver at scale in a supportive, collaborative environment that values kindness alongside ambition. You will help define sustainable technologies, make data transparent and usable across the business, and see your work accelerate how medicines are made and delivered.
Call to Action:
If you are ready to architect the data foundations of a pioneering manufacturing site and turn ideas into measurable impact for patients and colleagues, step forward and help us build what comes next.

title: AI and Automation Specialist in Logistics
description:
The AI & Automation Specialist – Logistics drives the identification, development, implementation and scaling of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and automation solutions across Warehousing, Transportation and Foreign Trade.
1. AI & Automation Strategy and Use-Case Management
Identify and prioritize AI, GenAI, Machine Learning, analytics and automation opportunities across logistics.
Build and maintain an AI & Automation roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data availability and implementation effort.
Translate logistics pain points into clearly defined digital use cases and technical requirements.
Develop business cases covering productivity, cost, service, quality, compliance and working-capital impact.
Drive solutions from PoC/pilot stage toward stable, scalable production applications.
Establish KPIs to measure adoption and realized business benefits.
2. Warehousing
Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities within inbound, storage, material movement, picking, packing and outbound processes.
Develop solutions for workload and capacity forecasting, resource planning, inventory optimization, warehouse productivity and exception handling.
Apply AI/computer vision/automation where appropriate for document processing, quality checks, material identification and transactional activities.
Support warehouse network and material-flow optimization using data analytics and simulation.
Enable intelligent decision support for warehouse supervisors and operational teams.
3. Transportation
Develop AI-supported solutions for transport planning, network design, routing, consolidation and carrier/LSP selection.
Apply predictive analytics for shipment volumes, transport capacity, lead times, freight cost and service performance.
Automate shipment tracking, exception management, reporting and freight-related administrative processes.
Combine shipment history, rate-card, TMS and operational data to support network and freight-cost optimization.
Develop advanced analytics and simulation solutions to identify savings and improve transport performance.
4. Foreign Trade & Customs
Identify AI and automation opportunities within import/export, customs clearance, trade agreements and foreign-trade compliance.
Automate document extraction, validation and reconciliation for customs and trade documentation.
Apply AI to support classification, plausibility checking, exception identification and compliance-related workflows while ensuring appropriate human validation.
Develop analytics for customs duties, Free Trade Agreement benefits, preferential treatment and process performance.
Improve data quality and interfaces between internal systems, service providers and customs-related processes.
5. Technology & Solution Development
Evaluate the most appropriate technology for each use case, including GenAI/LLMs, Machine Learning, predictive analytics, process automation/RPA, OCR/document intelligence, optimization algorithms and AI agents.
Work with platforms and systems such as SAP, TMS/WMS solutions, Microsoft Power Platform, Python/data platforms and enterprise AI solutions.
Define data requirements and collaborate with IT/data teams to establish reliable data pipelines and interfaces.
Ensure solutions comply with IT architecture, cybersecurity, data protection and AI governance requirements.
Evaluate make-versus-buy decisions and coordinate external technology partners where appropriate.
6. Implementation & Change Management
Lead cross-functional AI and automation projects with Operations, Process Owners, IT, Data/AI teams and external partners.
Develop prototypes rapidly, validate solutions with end users and convert successful prototypes into sustainable operational solutions.
Establish process ownership and support models after rollout.
Train logistics associates and process experts on AI-enabled tools.
Promote responsible AI adoption and build AI capabilities within the logistics organization.
Build a community of key users and identify opportunities for reuse and scaling across locations and processes.
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Data Science mandatory
• 2–5 years of relevant professional experience with AI and automation projects in logistics and supply chain management.
• Strong understanding of at least two of the following areas, with willingness to develop the third:
• Warehousing / Intralogistics
• Transportation / Freight Management
• Foreign Trade / Customs
• Practical industry experience delivering digitalization, analytics, automation or AI projects.
• Ability to understand operational processes and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Experience working with structured operational data and enterprise systems.
• Practical experience in Python and/or SQL. AI / Machine Learning and predictive analytics.

• Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress functionality, including custom post types, taxonomies, metadata, plugins, and editorial workflows.

• Develop and maintain REST APIs that support content delivery to web applications and other digital platforms.

• Collaborate with editorial, product, and engineering teams to translate publishing requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted workflows and automation.
• Continuously explore emerging AI development capabilities and adopt practical approaches that improve software delivery without compromising engineering standards.

## Engineering & Collaboration
• Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
• Develop automated tests and follow established CI/CD and deployment practices.
• Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Take ownership of assigned features and technical improvements from design through deployment.
• Identify opportunities to improve developer workflows, application performance, and code quality.

• Strong professional experience developing and maintaining production WordPress applications.
• Advanced knowledge of PHP 8+, object-oriented programming, and modern PHP development practices, including Composer and dependency management.
• Experience building custom WordPress plugins, post types, taxonomies, metadata, and REST APIs.

• Experience designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs.
• Working knowledge of Python, including experience developing backend applications, APIs, or background processing services.

Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent solutions, to improve development efficiency and code quality.

• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Experience with asynchronous Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Quart.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Experience with Redis, distributed caching, message queues, or event-driven systems.

title: Software Engineer II (BotStopper)
description:
## Who We Are
Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:
Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.
Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.
Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.
Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.
## What you’ll do
As a Software Engineer II on the BotStopper team, you will help build the cloud-native services and machine learning inference infrastructure powering Pindrop BotStopper™- our real-time AI voice detection solution that helps enterprises distinguish human callers from automated interactions and recognize known registered AI voices.
Built on Pindrop Pulse detection technology and supported by intelligence from the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC), BotStopper helps enterprises identify automated interactions, protect customer experiences, and respond to emerging AI-driven challenges across contact centers.
As a mid-level individual contributor, you'll bring solid backend engineering experience, take end-to-end ownership of assigned features and components, and collaborate closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to transform emerging technologies into secure, scalable, production-ready systems.
More specifically, you will:
• Develop, test, deploy, and monitor backend services and APIs supporting BotStopper's real-time detection and scoring capabilities, ensuring low latency, scalability, and reliability.
• Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned features and components from implementation and testing through production rollout and operational support.
• Help develop backend capabilities supporting known-AI-voice identification, including integration with the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC) infrastructure.
• Collaborate with Research to integrate detection models and ML-driven signals into production workflows.
• Actively participate in code reviews, sharing knowledge with peers and incorporating constructive feedback to improve code quality and maintainability.
• Design and develop backend services and APIs that support integrations with IVR, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), telephony, and conversational AI platforms.
• Support production operations through incident response, troubleshooting, and applying fixes to maintain system reliability. After an initial onboarding period of approximately three months, participate in the team's established on-call rotation.
• Utilize AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows, while responsibly validating generated code for correctness, security, and performance.
## Who you are
• You maintain momentum when navigating partial requirements or production issues, recovering quickly from setbacks to continue delivering independently.
• You share context, raise concerns constructively, and participate meaningfully in design and code review discussions with your peers.
• You consistently deliver production-ready services and APIs from start to finish, making sound engineering decisions based on available metrics and requirements.
• You build trust by being transparent about progress, risks, and blockers, accurately representing work status and system behavior.
• You use AI tools to accelerate development while thoughtfully reviewing and validating the output for correctness and security.
## Your skill-set
Must Have:
• 2–5 years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of shipping stable, secure code to production.
• Deep proficiency in Go, Python, or comparable backend programming languages, with a strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and concurrency patterns.
• Strong Linux/Unix fundamentals and proficiency with Docker and container orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes.
• Experience developing and operating cloud-native applications using AWS, GCP, or comparable platforms.
• Hands-on experience with production data or messaging technologies such as PostgreSQL/Aurora, Redis, Kinesis, or similar systems.
• Ability to participate in an on-call rotation to support low-latency production pipelines.
Nice to Have:
• Experience working with machine learning inference infrastructure, real-time scoring pipelines, or production ML model integrations.
• Experience with real-time voice processing, telephony, WebRTC, SIP/RTP, audio signal analysis, or integrations with IVR, CCaaS, and conversational AI platforms.
• Familiarity with additional cloud and data technologies such as Redshift, DynamoDB, S3, Elasticsearch, IAM, and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
• Experience in AI-agent detection, synthetic speech or deepfake detection, identity verification, cybersecurity, or other security-sensitive enterprise systems.
## What’s in it for you
The rise of AI voice agents is fundamentally changing how consumers and enterprises communicate. As automated callers become increasingly sophisticated, organizations need reliable ways to recognize machine-driven interactions and respond appropriately without disrupting legitimate customer experiences.
BotStopper represents an important step in Pindrop's broader AI-agent identity and trust strategy. This is an opportunity to help shape an evolving product at a pivotal moment in AI and cybersecurity. You'll tackle challenging problems involving distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and production machine learning while working alongside talented engineers, researchers, and product leaders.
• Your work will help enterprises identify automated voice interactions, protect contact-center capacity, and respond to emerging AI-driven risks while supporting legitimate customer experiences.
• Work on low-latency processing, distributed systems, cloud scalability, ML inference infrastructure, and reliable operation under high-volume production conditions.
• Collaborate with experienced software engineers, research scientists, ML engineers, and product leaders who value thoughtful debate, technical depth, and continuous improvement.
• Grow your career by learning to independently design solutions for complex problems and contributing to operational excellence, preparing you for the Senior Software Engineer level.
• AI is changing both what we build and how we build it. You'll be encouraged to incorporate AI responsibly into your development workflow, experiment with emerging tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality.
## What we offer
As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:
• Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
• Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies.
• Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year
• Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
• While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.

title: Frontend Software Engineer
description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.
Frontend Software Engineer
(React / Next.js)
Company: Newsweek
## About the Role
Newsweek is looking for a Frontend Software Engineer to help build, maintain, and enhance the digital experiences that serve our readers across our publishing platforms.
In this role, you will focus primarily on React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend engineering, developing fast, responsive, accessible, and scalable web applications that deliver content to a large and diverse audience.
You will work on a modern, API-driven frontend architecture, building reusable components, integrating content and backend services, and optimizing the performance and reliability of our digital products.
We are looking for an engineer who combines strong frontend fundamentals with a modern, AI-assisted approach to software development. You should be comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, solve problems, and streamline engineering workflows while maintaining ownership of the solutions you deliver.
The ideal candidate has solid experience building production-grade applications with React and Next.js, understands modern web performance and frontend architecture, and can collaborate effectively with design, product, backend, and engineering teams.
## What You'll Do
## Frontend Development & Architecture
• Develop, maintain, and enhance modern web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
• Build modular, reusable, and maintainable UI components that follow established design systems and engineering best practices.
• Implement responsive layouts and intuitive user experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
• Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, including REST and GraphQL, to deliver dynamic, content-driven experiences.
• Work with server-side rendering (SSR), static generation (SSG), and other modern rendering techniques to optimize application performance and content delivery.
• Collaborate with backend engineers to define efficient API contracts and data requirements.
• Contribute to frontend architecture decisions, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and consistency across digital products.
## Performance, Accessibility & User Experience
• Optimize frontend performance, including page load times, rendering efficiency, and resource utilization.
• Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals, including loading performance, responsiveness, and visual stability.
• Apply modern performance optimization techniques such as code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, and caching.
• Build accessible interfaces following web accessibility standards and best practices.
• Ensure consistent functionality across modern browsers and devices.
• Implement frontend solutions that support technical SEO, structured data, and search engine discoverability.
• Identify and resolve frontend performance issues, rendering problems, and user experience inconsistencies.
• Collaborate with product and design teams to translate requirements and designs into polished, reliable user interfaces.
## AI-Assisted Development & Engineering Productivity
• Effectively leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and code reviews.
• Use AI to assist with component development, refactoring, performance analysis, technical research, and implementation of new features.
• Critically evaluate, test, and validate AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, accessibility, performance, and maintainability.
• Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development workflows and automation.
• Continuously explore emerging AI development capabilities and adopt practical approaches that improve software delivery without compromising engineering standards.
• Follow company security and data privacy policies when using AI tools, ensuring sensitive information and proprietary code are handled appropriately.
## Engineering & Collaboration
• Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable frontend code.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
• Develop and maintain automated tests to improve application reliability and prevent regressions.
• Follow established CI/CD, version control, and deployment practices.
• Collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
• Take ownership of assigned features and technical improvements from initial development through production release.
• Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to ongoing improvements in code quality, development workflows, and application reliability.
## Required Qualifications
• Strong professional experience developing and maintaining production web applications using React and Next.js.
• Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and modern CSS.
• Solid understanding of React fundamentals, including hooks, component composition, state management, and rendering behavior.
• Experience with Next.js routing, data fetching, server-side rendering, static generation, and modern application architecture.
• Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
• Strong understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility best practices.
• Experience optimizing web applications for performance, including Core Web Vitals, asset loading, and rendering efficiency.
• Familiarity with modern styling approaches such as CSS Modules, SCSS, or utility-first CSS frameworks.
• Experience building reusable components and working with shared design systems.
• Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks and tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress.
• Experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD development workflows.
Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent solutions, to improve development efficiency and code quality.
• Demonstrated ability to critically review, validate, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying on it without verification.
• Understanding of responsible AI usage in software development, including security, intellectual property, and data privacy considerations.
• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced development environment.
## Nice to Have
• Experience building applications using headless CMS platforms, particularly WordPress.
• Familiarity with WPGraphQL, WordPress REST APIs, or other content delivery APIs.
• Experience with high-traffic, content-heavy websites or digital publishing platforms.
• Knowledge of advanced Next.js features, including server components, streaming, incremental static regeneration, and caching strategies.
• Experience with CDN technologies, edge caching, and frontend content delivery optimization.
• Experience with frontend monitoring, error tracking, and performance analysis tools.
• Familiarity with SEO requirements for news and publishing websites, including structured data and metadata management.
• Experience integrating analytics, advertising, subscriptions, or audience engagement technologies.
• Knowledge of web security best practices, including content security policies, XSS prevention, and secure API integration.
• Experience with visual regression testing, component libraries, or Storybook.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerized application deployments.
• Experience improving engineering processes through AI-assisted automation, testing, or development workflows.
• Previous experience working with digital publishing, media, or other large-scale consumer-facing web applications.
## What Success Looks Like
• You deliver fast, reliable, and engaging frontend experiences that serve Newsweek's readers across devices.
• You build reusable, maintainable components that accelerate development and support consistent user experiences.
• You continuously improve application performance, accessibility, SEO, and Core Web Vitals.
• You integrate frontend applications effectively with backend APIs and content management systems.
• You effectively use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, and maintain high code quality.
• You demonstrate sound engineering judgment, including the ability to recognize when AI-generated solutions require modification or should not be used.
• You take ownership of your work and collaborate effectively with product, design, backend, and engineering teams.
• You contribute to a high-quality codebase through testing, documentation, code reviews, and thoughtful engineering practices.
Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

title: Software Engineer II (Backend)
description:
Join the team turning internet intelligence into real-world security outcomes. Built on the world’s most comprehensive and accurate map of the Internet, the Censys Platform delivers real-time visibility and actionable intelligence needed to accelerate triage, investigate threats, hunt adversaries, and manage Internet exposure. We're trusted by half of the Fortune 500 and government agencies all around the world, and looking for people as passionate about the problems we're solving as we are.
At Censys, we're on a mission to provide best in class internet visibility and intelligence to the global security community. Our platform helps security teams uncover hidden threats, gain actionable insights, and build proactive defense strategies. Trusted by organizations worldwide, Censys cuts through the noise to surface the most critical risks, enabling teams to respond faster, and stay ahead of attackers. We're constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible to help our customers see and secure the internet more clearly than ever before.
## Location:
This position is remote within the United States or Canada.
## Role Summary:
Censys is seeking a Software Engineer II (Backend) to join our Exposure Management team. Exposure Management is a growth product for Censys. It combines our map of the Internet with customer context to show security teams which exposures matter most, including the risk that reaches them through their suppliers via Supplier Risk Intelligence. We're looking for an engineer who can build the product APIs behind these experiences, taking a well-scoped feature from design through launch with input from senior engineers.
You'll work primarily in Go, pulling together data and services from other Censys teams and partnering with frontend engineers to deliver APIs that are fast, well-shaped, and easy to build on. As with all roles at Censys, we expect a strong customer focus, a collaborative mindset, and a desire to keep learning.
## What You'll Do:
• Own small-to-medium product API features end to end, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration
• Build and extend the public REST and gRPC APIs behind Exposure Management and Supplier Risk Intelligence, including the risk event endpoints that power SIEM integrations with Splunk, Google SecOps, and Microsoft Sentinel
• Partner with frontend engineers and product stakeholders on API contracts, filtering, pagination, and response shapes so customer-facing experiences stay fast and simple to build
• Work with other Censys teams to integrate their data and services through gRPC and GCP PubSub, and agree on interfaces that hold up as both sides evolve
• Profile and optimize API performance, from Postgres query plans and indexing to caching and payload size
• Write tests, add observability, and take release and on-call responsibility for the services you ship
• Bring customer feedback into design discussions and help onboard interns and newer engineers in your area
## What You'll Bring:
• A positive attitude biased towards action and iterative problem solving, learning as we grow every step of the way.
• 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services.
• Production experience with Go, or strong experience in another backend language (Python, Java) and the drive to become proficient in Go quickly.
• Experience designing and consuming REST or gRPC APIs, ideally ones consumed by a frontend application.
• Solid SQL skills and working knowledge of relational data modeling, indexing, and query performance.
• A track record of building maintainable software: tests enforced in CI, meaningful monitoring and alerting, and thoughtful code reviews.
• Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, product managers, and other teams.
• Curiosity and a willingness to pick up new domains, tools, and parts of the stack.
## What Sets You Apart:
• Experience on security products, especially attack surface management, third-party risk or vulnerability management.
• Experience building APIs that external developers or partners integrate against (OpenAPI specs, versioning, webhooks).
• Experience with event-driven systems (GCP PubSub, Kafka) and patterns like idempotency and retries.
• Experience deploying containerized services on Kubernetes in GCP or AWS.
• Fluency with AI coding tools as a force multiplier for building better software.
• A working understanding of how the Internet works. DNS record types, WHOIS, and Certificate Subject Alternative Names (SANs) are familiar territory
For high cost of living areas (San Francisco Bay, New York City, and Seattle), the expected salary range for this position is $137,000 USD - $164,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.
For all other US locations, the expected salary range for this position is $116,450 USD - $140,500 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.
In addition to our great compensation package, our benefits are effective on day one and include but are not limited to: 401k match, health, vision, dental, and more! Please see our careers page for more details.
Our roots are in Ann Arbor, Michigan and our innovation is fueled by the team's global perspectives. For this role, we are open to remote employees across the continental US or Canada.

title: DevOps Engineer (w/m/d) - Cloud & Platform Engineering
description:
## AI macht uns schneller. Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab.
Was AI produziert, überprüfen wir. Für alles, was rausgeht, stehen wir gerade.
Beim Ausprobieren sind wir schnell, beim Ausliefern gründlich.
Baue die Plattform, auf der unsere Entwickler gerne arbeiten.
Keine Tickets für eine Datenbank. Kein Warten auf eine funktionierende Pipeline. Keine manuellen Übergaben, wenn Automatisierung die bessere Lösung ist.
Baue stattdessen eine Plattform, die Entwickler befähigt, schnell, sicher und selbstständig zu liefern.
Übernimm Verantwortung für unsere Google Cloud Platform, GKE/Kubernetes, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code. Automatisiere, was sich automatisieren lässt. Hinterfrage Bestehendes. Und entwickle unsere Plattform kontinuierlich weiter.
## Deine Mission
Gestalte die Developer Experience: Baue Self-Service-Lösungen und automatisierte Workflows, die unsere Entwickler schneller und unabhängiger machen.
Übernimm die Cloud: Entwickle und betreibe unsere Cloud-Infrastruktur sowie GKE/Kubernetes-Umgebungen – skalierbar, resilient und zuverlässig. Bring deine Cloud-Expertise ein und entwickle unsere Plattform kontinuierlich weiter.
Automatisiere CI/CD: Optimiere unsere Pipelines und integriere Qualität, Security und Reliability direkt in den Entwicklungsprozess.
Code deine Infrastruktur: Nutze Terraform, Infrastructure as Code und Scripting, um manuelle Arbeit durch reproduzierbare Automatisierung zu ersetzen.
Denke Security mit: Identifiziere Risiken frühzeitig und verankere Security direkt in unserer Plattform und unseren Delivery-Prozessen.
Schaffe Transparenz: Nutze Monitoring, Logging und Observability, um Probleme früh zu erkennen und unsere Systeme kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Übernimm Ownership: Hinterfrage bestehende Lösungen, treibe Verbesserungen selbstständig voran und begleite deine Lösungen von der Idee bis in die Produktion.
## Deine Skills
Bring 5+ Jahre praktische Erfahrung mitin DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, SRE oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld.
Bring praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie Google Cloud Platform (GCP) und/oder AWS sowie mit produktiven Cloud-Umgebungen mit.
Arbeite sicher mit Kubernetes;Erfahrung mit Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) oder vergleichbaren Managed-Kubernetes-Services ist von Vorteil.
Nutze Infrastructure as Code, insbesondere Terraform.
Baue und betreibe CI/CD-Pipelines und verbinde Geschwindigkeit mit Qualität und Sicherheit.
Arbeite souverän mit Linux und containerisierten Umgebungen.
Automatisiere mit Shell und/oder Python.
Übernimm Verantwortung end-to-end und bringe Themen eigenständig in die Produktion.
Denke systemisch und verstehe das Zusammenspiel von Cloud, Kubernetes, Security, CI/CD und Developer Experience.
Kommuniziere klar und entwickle gemeinsam mit Engineering pragmatische Lösungen.
Bonus-XP:Prometheus & Grafana, Graylog, Jenkins, Ansible, Python, Cloud Security, Observability & SRE.
## Was dich bei uns erwartet
Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle.
Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran.
Build > Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen.
Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen.
Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und Community-Austausch, um fachlich dazuzulernen.
Und natürlich stimmen auch die Rahmenbedingungen: 30 Urlaubstage plus frei am 24. und 31. Dezember, Smart Fridays mit der Möglichkeit einer Vier-Tage-Woche, Deutschlandticket und JobRad, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote, Unterstützung für die mentale Gesundheit, Corporate Benefits, Zugang zu RTL+ und vieles mehr.
## Dein Lebenslauf ist nur der Anfang.
Was uns mehr interessiert als dein Lebenslauf: ein Portfolio, ein Side Project oder ein Demo-Repo – etwas, das zeigt, wie du technische Probleme angehst und Lösungen umsetzt.

title: Full Stack Developer (AI-First)
description:
Location:This role is fully remote and open only to candidates based in Latin America. We're not able to consider candidates based in the US or other regions for this position. Our dev team works on Eastern Time (ET).
## How we build
We don't type code. Our engineers work through agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and most of what ships is agent-written. You describe the outcome, the agent plans and implements, the agent reviews its own work, and then you review it.
The first and the last steps are the job. You set the shape before the agent builds, and you're the first human to read what comes back. You own every line that lands in production. Whole-team PR review sits on top of that, not instead of it. "The agent wrote it" never explains a bug here.
Company accounts for Claude, Codex and Cursor are provided and you're expected to use them hard. No token budget to ration.
## What you'll do
• Ship merchant-facing features end to end, from data model to API to UI, directing agents through the whole path
• Decide the shape before the agent builds it: where a boundary goes, what's sync vs. queued, what the contract is, what gets denormalized
• Catch what the agent got wrong: the plausible-looking query that doesn't scale, the missing failure path, the abstraction that will cost us in six months
• Make agent output verifiable with tests that define done, contracts that hold, and changes that can be rolled back
• Bring new tooling and workflows into the team when you find something better
## What we're looking for
Web development and web services architecture. That's the bar, not a specific language.
• 3+ years building and running production web applications
• You reason fluently about client-server, sync vs. async, scheduling and background work, caching, and failure modes, and you can explain a decision to an agent well enough that it builds the right thing
• Architectural patterns are working tools for you, not vocabulary: MVC, layered, hexagonal, DDD, and the code-level patterns underneath. You know when each is worth it and when it's overhead
• Strong SQL and relational data modeling. Non-negotiable
• You instrument what you ship. Production observability and performance tooling (Datadog, New Relic, Sentry or similar) is how you find out the agent's code actually works
• Daily production use of coding agents. You ship with them, you're not evaluating them
• You can take a codebase you didn't write and an agent's plan for changing it, and tell whether the plan is right
Any language. PHP/Laravel and JavaScript/Vue are a plus. That's our current stack and you'll be in it week one, with agents to get you there.
Also a plus: LLM APIs in production, e-commerce platforms (Shopify, fulfillment), queues and event-driven work, MCP servers or custom agent skills.
## Interview process
• Intro with our HR Manager
• Technical conversation with a Tech Lead and the CTO. Expect to review real agent-generated code and defend architectural calls
• Conversation with the CTO of our parent company

## Job Description
Team Overview
Reporting to the People Analytics BI Enablement Leader with the People Analytics organization, the HR Data Engineer along with peers enable the People Analytics business intelligence (BI) strategy. This role collaborates across the BI Enablement team and with partner groups to assemble large datasets, build clear metric definitions, integrate data, certify data products, and scale actionable insights using Databricks technology.

title: Full Stack Engineer

Location Requirement
Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.
What we need
• Excel at defining the vision around delivering business-impacting goals
• I rapidly deliver against large, cross-funtional, high-impact projects, proactively identifying and mititgigate risk.
• I can clearly communicate with executive level stakeholders both internally and externally
• Work with our tech stack: Ruby on Rails, Postgres, Typescript, React, GraphQL, NextJS, AWS
• Help distill the core interactions a customer of Reserv will need to be successful in using our product, from the homepage, to the developer dashboard, to documentation centers and SDKs
• Ship code that improves the developer experience, including the homepage, developer dashboard, Connect, SDKs, and the documentation center
• Build frontend and backend components that improve the Reserv integration experience
• Commit on your first day, and deploy code continuously
• Support developers at customer companies
• As we scale our product & engineering teams, collaborate closely with our product ops, design, and sales teams, as well as mentor junior engineers
• Communicate ideas and specifications through detailed, precise writing
• Influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing engineering team
• Support the engineering function globally

## Cloud Platform Engineer
## An overview of this role
As a Cloud Platform Engineer on the Runway team, you'll help design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and developer tooling that powers our engineering organization. You'll advance our Kubernetes-based platform, mature our GitOps practices, and expand infrastructure as code adoption across the business. This hands-on role brings together infrastructure, automation, and developer experience, helping application teams deploy and operate their services.
## What you’ll do
• Operate and improve production Kubernetes clusters across cloud environments, managing upgrades, scaling, and reliability throughout the cluster lifecycle.
• Own and extend Argo CD-based GitOps workflows, maintaining ApplicationSets, managing sync policies, and enforcing deployment standards across environments.
• Write, review, and maintain reusable Terraform modules, with clear practices for state management and drift detection.
• Monitor platform health, respond to incidents, conduct post-mortems, and improve availability, performance, and observability.
• Collaborate with application teams to onboard services, and create documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling that improves developer productivity.
• Implement role-based access control, network policies, and secrets management to meet infrastructure security and compliance requirements.
• Integrate platform capabilities with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to support end-to-end delivery workflows.
## What you’ll bring
• Experience operating Kubernetes in production and working with at least one major cloud provider: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
• Experience with Argo CD or comparable GitOps tooling, such as Flux.
• Proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning, including remote state, workspaces, and module design.
• Ability to write scripts and automation in Python, Bash, or Go.
• Familiarity with Helm for Kubernetes package management.
• Understanding of networking fundamentals, including the Domain Name System (DNS), load balancing, ingress, and service mesh concepts.
• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document systems and collaborate across teams.
• Optional: experience with managed, multi-cluster, or multi-region Kubernetes, service meshes, policy as code, observability, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure as code; open source or platform tooling contributions; or relevant certifications.
## About the team
The Runway team builds and maintains infrastructure and developer tooling for GitLab's engineering organization. Its work centers on a Kubernetes-based platform, GitOps delivery practices, and infrastructure as code. The team collaborates with application teams to onboard services and improve developer productivity through documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Canonical is looking for exceptional security-focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state-of-the-art practices such as threat modeling, table-top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others.
These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open source ecosystem.
Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security-oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long-term security response for the entire operating system and open source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.
Apply here if you are an exceptional security-focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.
This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self-discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.
Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role
## What you'll do
Security roles might tackle any of the following:
• Define, implement, and document new security features
• Lead security-focused initiatives within a product engineering team
• Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
• Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community
• Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
• Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
• Achieve and retain various security certifications
• Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country-specific compliance requirements, such as FIPS and Common Criteria (CC) certifications
• Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
• Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
• Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
• Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
• Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices
## What we are looking for in you
• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
• A track record of going above and beyond expectations
• Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
• Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
• Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
• Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
• Experience as a security champion
• Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process
• Professional written and spoken English
• Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
• Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
• Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Results-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
## Optional skills we also value
• Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
• Experience working with the Linux kernel
• Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
• Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
• Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
• Knowledge of low-level Linux cryptography APIs
• Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
• Performance engineering experience
## What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Maternity and paternity leave
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
• Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
## About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
## Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
#LI-remote

• Great financial package - Including salary, bonus, pension, private healthcare, share save scheme, flexible working & holiday policy along with a number of other benefits.
ABOUT FANDUEL
FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.
In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.
The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.
FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer. Diversity and inclusion in FanDuel means that we respect and value everyone as individuals. We don't tolerate bias, judgement or harassment. Our focus is on developing employees so that they reach their full potential.
FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com.

title: Research Engineer, Inference Foundation
description:
## About Mistral
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
## The Role
The Inference Foundation team owns the core of Mistral's inference stack: the inference engine and its orchestration, from the feature set and configuration that serve our models in production to the release machinery that keeps the stack current and production-grade.
This is a hybrid position spanning production LLM serving, engine and platform development, and capacity engineering. You will work on three intertwined problems:
Optimize the inference stack at scale — feature development and fixes in the engine and orchestrator, squeezing more throughput and lower latency out of every GPU under strict quality-of-service targets.
Make capacity elastic — scaling up and down should be cheap and fast, not a performance cliff.
Power the training of our frontier models — high-performance serving that keeps RL and post-training loops running at full speed.
What You Will Do
## Inference engine & orchestration
Develop and fix the core of the inference stack — engine and orchestrator — including feature selection, configuration, and tuning for maximum performance at scale
Own the release process for the serving stack: validated, regression-free releases through automated performance gates and progressive rollout
Drive improvements and fixes upstream when the open-source engine is the right place for them
## Performance & capacity at scale
Optimize serving efficiency across the fleet — driving down pod startup time, tackling cold-cache regressions on scale-up, smarter caching and offloading
Optimize and maintain the optimal serving topology — overlap communication and transfers with computation, ensure optimal placement, connectivity, and routing
## Serving for frontier training
Build the serving infrastructure that powers RL and post-training for our frontier models
Optimize inference performance across the full spectrum of our workloads
What We're Looking For
Experience building and running ML/LLM services at scale, with clear latency and availability targets
Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or others
A solid grasp of inference internals: prefill vs. decode, KV-cache behavior, batching, scheduling, speculative decoding, parallelism strategies
Familiarity with distributed and disaggregated serving architectures
Comfortable debugging across the full stack — CUDA/NCCL, kernels, containers, networking, storage
Python for systems tooling and backend services; PyTorch
Kubernetes for running infrastructure at scale
GPU and networking fundamentals: CUDA runtime, NCCL, InfiniBand/RDMA
It Would Be Great If You Have
Demonstrated vLLM/sglang know-how — upstream contributions, or a track record of running in demanding production environments
Hardware-aware optimization for various model architectures
Experience serving MoE models at scale (expert parallelism, expert placement/load balancing)
CUDA/Triton kernel development; Nsight Systems/Compute profiling
Rust and/or C++ in production systems
## What We Offer
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Networking (TLS, DNS, ingress, load balancing) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
Enterprise integration knowledge: SSO, secrets management, security and compliance.
Hands-on Python and Bash, plus strong AI fluency with agentic toolsets for triage, debugging and IaC.
Consulting or professional services background.
A track record of running several customer engagements in parallel and communicating clearly with technical and business stakeholders.

Experience with deepset’s Haystack Enterprise Platform (HEP) or Haystack open source framework
German Native, Business fluent
Sovereign or air-gapped deployments (STACKIT, OVHcloud, IONOS) and GPU/LLM serving (vLLM, NVIDIA GPU Operator)
Certifications such as CKA, CKS or Red Hat OpenShift
## Benefits
Remote-first setup with flexible hours & tech of your choice
30 days vacation + extra days for family sick leave
Competitive salary & stock options for every team member
Monthly sports & mental health support allowance with Oliva
Annual learning & development budget
Monthly team socials & in-person meetups
Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

Founded in 2018, deepset builds open and enterprise-grade tools that help teams build AI with purpose. From Haystack, our open-source framework, to the Haystack Enterprise Platform, we give developers and organizations the building blocks to solve complex, high impact challenges with AI with full control, transparency, and sovereignty. title: AI and Digital Solutions Engineer
description:

Reports To Operations Director
Direct Reports None
Grade / Band Graduate
Location UK Hybrid (Bracknell)
Employment Type Full-time
Budget Responsibility None
Purpose of the Role
TrustFlight’s Operations department delivers a high volume of aviation safety training, consultancy, and compliance services to clients globally. As the business scales, the administrative and coordination burden across scheduling, travel, contracting, and client communications has grown significantly.
This role exists to identify, design, and implement digital and AI-powered solutions that automate and streamline the operational workflows underpinning consultant scheduling, travel logistics, contractor management, and client-facing communications — including course joining instructions, certificates, course materials, and Microsoft Teams setup.
The AI & Digital Solutions Engineer will act as the bridge between operational need and technology capability, transforming manual, repetitive processes into scalable, intelligent workflows that free the wider team to focus on high-value delivery. Whilst Operations is the primary focus, the role will also extend AI and automation capability into Business Development and Product, supporting pipeline workflows, proposal generation, and product feedback processes as the function matures.
Scope & Decision-Making Authority
Design, build, and deploy automation solutions for agreed operational workflows using AI and no-code/low-code tooling, within a structured support framework during the initial onboarding period.
Select and recommend appropriate tools and platforms for workflow automation, within agreed budget parameters and subject to IT governance sign-off.
Propose and pilot new digital solutions with line manager oversight, progressing toward greater autonomy as experience and confidence develop.
Escalate to Operations Director for significant new vendor contracts, material changes to client-facing communications, or solutions that touch personal or sensitive data.
Cross-functional coordination with Training Delivery, Consulting, Client Success, Business Development, and Product teams to gather requirements and implement agreed solutions.
Scope covers Operations as the primary function, with cross-functional remit extending to Business Development and Product from day one.
Key Relationships
Internal
Operations Director — regular check-in on priorities, solution sign-off, and strategic alignment.
Operations Coordinators, Admins & Consultants — day-to-day requirements gathering, testing, and adoption support for new workflows.
IT & Engineering — technical governance, data security review, and integration support where required.
Senior Leadership Team — periodic reporting on operational efficiency gains and automation ROI.
Business Development Team — automation of proposal generation, CRM workflows, and pipeline reporting.
Product Team — digital tooling support for product feedback loops, release communications, and internal reporting.
External
Training & Consultancy Clients — automated and semi-automated communications for joining instructions, certificates, course materials, and Teams invitations.
Contractors & Freelance Consultants — digital onboarding, contracting, scheduling notifications, and engagement management.
Software & Platform Vendors — procurement, configuration, and ongoing management of automation and scheduling tools.
Key Responsibilities
Audit and map current operational workflows — including consultant scheduling, travel booking, contractor contracting, and client communications — to identify automation and AI opportunities.
Design and build end-to-end digital workflows using AI tools, automation platforms, and scheduling systems to reduce manual effort across the Operations team.
Implement intelligent scheduling solutions for consultant time allocation, ensuring visibility of availability, conflict resolution, and automated notifications to all parties.
Automate the full client communication lifecycle for training and consultancy engagements, including generation and dispatch of joining instructions, course materials, Teams meeting invitations, and post-course certificates.
Build and maintain a digital contractor management workflow covering sourcing triggers, contract generation, engagement tracking, and payment milestone coordination.
Own the technology stack for Operations automation — evaluating tools, managing licences, and ensuring solutions remain fit for purpose as the business evolves.
Champion adoption of new digital workflows across the Operations team, providing training, documentation, and ongoing support.
Monitor solution performance, identify failure points, and continuously improve automations to increase reliability and coverage.
Support the Business Development team with AI-assisted proposal workflows, CRM automation, and pipeline visibility tooling to accelerate the sales cycle.
Collaborate with the Product team to design and implement digital solutions that streamline product feedback collection, internal reporting, and release communication processes.
Key Metrics for Success
Within 90 days: Full audit of operational workflows completed and an automation roadmap agreed with the Operations Director.
Within 6 months: At least 3 core workflows automated (e.g. consultant scheduling notifications, client joining instructions, contractor contract generation), with measurable reduction in manual processing time of ≥40%.
Within 12 months: End-to-end automation coverage across scheduling, travel coordination triggers, client communications, and contractor onboarding, delivering a quantified saving of ≥60 hours/week for the Operations team.
Client communication error rate (wrong materials, missed invites, late certificates) reduced to <1% of engagements.
Stakeholder satisfaction score of 4+/5 from internal Operations team on quality and usability of implemented solutions.
Deliver at least one agreed automation solution for each of Business Development and Product within the first 12 months.
AI & Digital Competency
TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation. Every role is expected to actively engage with AI tools and digital ways of working to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation.
AI Fluency Tier
Tier Profile Expectations Tier 3 — AI Builder ✓ Develops and integrates AI-powered solutions Builds, fine-tunes, or integrates AI/ML models and pipelines. Establishes evaluation frameworks for AI systems. Ensures responsible AI practices (fairness, transparency, data governance). Contributes to TrustFlight’s AI strategy.
Role-Specific AI & Digital Skills
Design and deploy AI-assisted scheduling systems that intelligently match consultant availability to client demand, accounting for skills, location, and travel constraints.
Use LLM-powered tools to auto-generate personalised client communications — joining instructions, Teams invites, course materials packs, and post-course certificates.
Build AI-assisted contractor matching and contract generation workflows, reducing turnaround time from requirement to signed agreement.
Apply AI tools for document classification and routing — ensuring the right materials reach the right clients at the right time.
Leverage AI-powered analytics to surface operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements proactively.
AI Development & Growth
Complete TrustFlight’s AI fluency onboarding programme within first 30 days.
Share automation wins, prompt libraries, and AI use cases with the wider team on a quarterly basis.
Actively participate in TrustFlight’s internal AI community of practice, contributing Operations-specific use cases and learnings.
Competencies & Behaviours
Innovation — Proactively identifies and implements technology-driven improvements; comfortable experimenting with new tools and approaches.
Delivery Focus — Takes ownership of solutions end-to-end; balances speed of iteration with stability and reliability of outputs.
Collaboration — Builds trust with non-technical stakeholders; listens carefully to operational needs before designing solutions.
Customer Centricity — Keeps the client experience and consultant wellbeing central to every workflow decision.
Analytical Thinking — Breaks down complex, multi-step processes into logical components; uses data to prioritise and validate improvements.
Adaptability — Thrives in a fast-moving environment; adjusts priorities readily as operational needs evolve.
Working Arrangements
Working Hours 37.5 hours per week, core hours 09:00–17:00
Work Pattern Hybrid — minimum 3 days office (Bracknell) for first 6 months, 2–3 days thereafter
Travel Requirements None
Anticipated On-Call / Shift Work None
Special Conditions Right to work in the UK required
Required Qualifications & Experience
A degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical discipline — achieved or expected at 2:1 or above.
Demonstrated academic study of AI and machine learning concepts, including LLMs, automation, or intelligent systems — evidenced through coursework, dissertations, modules, or equivalent self-directed learning.
Ability to demonstrate understanding of how AI tools can be applied to real-world process automation, through academic projects, coursework examples, or personal study.
Familiarity with at least one automation or no-code/low-code platform (e.g. Make, Power Automate, n8n, Zapier) — whether through university projects, personal experimentation, or placement experience.
Comfortable working analytically with data and processes — able to break down a workflow logically and identify where technology can add value.
Strong communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for non-technical colleagues and listen carefully before designing solutions.
Organised, reliable, and able to manage competing priorities — follows through on commitments and flags issues early.
Desirable Skills & Experience
Placement year, internship, or part-time experience in a technology, operations, or business environment.
Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (e.g. Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT) in a project or academic context.
Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, particularly Teams, as a communications and workflow platform.
Exposure to APIs, webhooks, or data integration between SaaS platforms.
Experience with document generation tools or CRM platforms.
Awareness of UK GDPR and data privacy considerations as they apply to automated communications and personal data.
Interest in or knowledge of aviation, professional services, or regulated industries.

  • Hands-on experience administering, configuring, or optimising conversational AI, chatbots, virtual assistants, or digital self-service platforms
  • Proven ability to analyse user behaviour and performance data to identify improvement opportunities and translate them into tangible actions
  • Experience with platforms such as Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI, Ada or similar is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or no-code/low-code automation tools is a plus
Skills:
  • User experience mindset: identifying friction points and translating insights into more intuitive, effective experiences

Automate the employee lifecycle: build, test, deploy and maintain workflows for recruiting-to-onboarding handoffs, employee changes, learning administration and offboarding.

Test the market: pilot new AI features and tools, and move them to production when relevant.
Spot new opportunities: bring workflow and agent ideas from People teams to the People Strategy & Tech Lead, with a first view of effort and value.

Treat People workflow like product code: keep clear documentation, schemas and runbooks for every workflow and agent: purpose, dependencies, logic, owner, monitoring and change history.
Keep an inventory: maintain an up-to-date list of the automations, agents, integrations and prompts you support, and retire what no longer works.
Measure service health: track success rate, processing time, answer quality, escalation rate and incidents, and report them to the People Strategy & Tech Lead regularly.
Apply responsible AI controls: implement the access, data and human-review requirements defined by Security, Privacy and Legal, and re-test after any model, data or configuration change.
Support adoption: write short guides and release notes, and help People teams use what you build.
Work within company standards: build with the stack and follow the IT and security guidelines set by the Data & Automation team, and document your work so others can support it when you are away.

The builder mindset: you have built workflows or integrations that other people actually use, with tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato or Power Automate. Scripting (SQL, Python or JavaScript) or expert-level spreadsheet logic is a strong plus.
AI-fluent: you know how to prompt LLMs, you have built or tested an agent or an AI assistant, and you are excited to replace repetitive human steps with reliable automation.
Systems thinking: you understand APIs, webhooks, structured data, permissions and conditional logic, and you know how automated services fail.
People curiosity: you understand or you are interested in core HR processes (hiring, onboarding, internal mobility, offboarding, payroll inputs) and can turn a process owner's needs into system logic.

Clear communicator: you explain technical choices and trade-offs to non-technical partners, and you document as you go.
Education: degree in engineering, data, information systems, business school with a focus on BI or information systems. Self-taught builders with strong evidence of work are welcome.
Fluency in English.

Experience automating or deploying AI inside an HR or People team.
Hands-on time with HiBob, Lever or similar HRIS and ATS tools, or with a ticketing and knowledge-base tool.
Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent evaluation or AI-assisted development tools.
Experience working with Security, Privacy or Legal teams, or knowledge of GDPR and responsible AI in employment processes.

Priority automations live in production, each with a measurable drop in manual work, processing time or errors.
Self-service agent launched with tested answer quality, approved sources and clear escalation paths.
