We are the TikTok Local Service Search team, building search algorithms that power both general search and the local services vertical, connecting user needs with places (POIs), products, and videos. Our users discover restaurants, hotels, and destinations through video content, then turn to search to learn more, compare options, and make decisions. We combine the understanding, generation, and reasoning capabilities of large language models with search and personalization technology, aiming to improve information access, support purchase decisions, and drive transaction efficiency throughout this journey.
What You'll Do
Depending on your experience, you will focus on one or more of the following areas:
1. POI Search & NLP Infrastructure
Own query understanding, content understanding, relevance, and POI retrieval, ranking, and result presentation. Leverage LLMs to understand multilingual expressions of places, categories, budgets, and search intents, and extract structured information from videos and location data to power search. Combine semantic retrieval, geolocation signals, and click/conversion prediction to improve the accuracy and relevance of restaurant, hotel, and other search results. Apply these capabilities to the online search pipeline through LLM-based labeling, training data development, model fine-tuning, and distillation, and explore approaches such as generative retrieval.
2. Video Ranking & Personalization
Own retrieval, ranking, and personalization modeling for local services video search. Use LLMs to interpret the places, services, and consumption experiences featured in videos, assess their relevance and information value to user queries, and feed these insights into training data and ranking models. Optimize multiple objectives — including clicks, content consumption, and transaction conversion — using user interests, location, and behavioral sequences, so users can more easily find videos that are relevant to their immediate needs and rich in useful information.
3. AI Search & Local Services Agent
Build agentic search experiences for restaurant, hotel, and travel needs. Combine LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multimodal understanding to organize evidence-based answers from videos, location data, and user experiences, helping users compare options. Explore multi-turn intent clarification, context and preference memory, and tool use, enabling users to progressively refine their searches by location, budget, party size, and more. Contribute to model training, effect evaluation, and the rollout of search products.

title: Research Scientist Intern, LLM-Native Recommendation Systems (PhD)

We build tools, create frameworks, and train models that we deploy together with product and infrastructure teams to gain adoption across the FoA. At FOMO Group, we are dedicated to redefining what is possible in digital payments, global banking, investment solutions, and tokenized assets. We seek forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for innovation and are eager to lead industry disruption. As part of our transformation journey, you will work alongside visionary leaders with a proven track record of shaping the future of finance.
We believe in unlocking the potential of every individual. We offer an inclusive, supportive, and continuous learning culture where everyone can grow to their full potential and achieve their personal and professional goals. Join our team and be part of an exciting evolution in the industry.
For more information, please visit www.fomogroup.com.
About the Role!
FOMO is looking for a Data Analyst to own the reporting data layer behind its payments and cross-border business. Working with Payments, Cross-border, Finance, Compliance and BD, the role turns broad questions such as “how are corridors performing?” into precise, testable metric definitions, and builds the Kimball-style data marts, specs and business glossary behind them. It also validates each mart against source and finance figures, prototypes the first Holistics dashboards, and owns data quality and metric consistency, starting with the Finance Dashboard for Product and Finance.
Key Responsibilities:
● Capture reporting needs from business owners and convert them into metric definitions, dimensions, filters and refresh requirements.
● Map each need to its source systems: ledgers, merchant onboarding, KYC/KYT, settlement and CRM.
● Write data mart specs and star-schema models, including facts, dimensions, keys and SCD handling.
● Write source-to-target mappings with column-level logic and sample SQL, plus ERDs and lineage diagrams kept alongside the dbt models.
● Maintain the business glossary (GMV, net revenue, take rate, FX margin, active merchants, settlement TAT) and keep metrics consistent across reports.
● Profile source data in SQL, write acceptance and reconciliation tests (mart vs. ledger and finance reports), and run UAT and sign-off before release.
● Prototype first dashboards and datasets in Holistics.
● Flag data quality issues to source owners and track them to resolution.
● Enable self-service through documentation, training and office hours.
Requirements:
● Bachelor’s degree in a relevant or equivalent field.
● 3–5 years of experience in data analysis, BI or analytics engineering, including at least one role that involved designing reporting or data mart models.
● Strong SQL skills: window functions, CTEs, complex joins and aggregation at mixed grains. You are comfortable profiling large tables.
● Solid grasp of dimensional modelling (Kimball): facts vs. dimensions, grain, conformed dimensions, SCD Type 1/2, and snapshot vs. transaction facts.
● A track record of writing clear specs, such as mapping documents, metric definitions and data dictionaries, that engineers could build from without rework.
● Able to work with business stakeholders, push back on ambiguious requests, and turn them into testable definitions.
● Experience with at least one BI tool (Holistics, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or Metabase).
● Fluent written and spoken English and Mandarin to speak with both internal and external stakeholders.
● Experience in payments, fintech or cross-border businesses.
● Hands-on experience with dbt and version-controlled documentation.
Our Perks and Benefits:

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) drives enterprise operational resilience by architecting scalable cloud infrastructure, managing the enterprise DevOps toolchain, and ensuring centralized system observability across hybrid cloud environments. • Resilience & Documentation: Execute disaster recovery (DR), backup, redundancy, and capacity planning strategies while maintaining high-quality runbooks and operational documentation.

title: Research Scientist Intern, MSL - Multimodal Interaction and Generation (PhD)
description:
Meta is seeking Research Scientist Interns to join a research team in Singapore working on real-time audio-visual interaction and generation. The team builds models that understand and generate media from text, audio, and images, and serves them interactively at low latency. The role sits at the intersection of multimodal understanding, agentic generation, and efficient modeling. Interns work on open research problems with a direct path to product, and are encouraged to publish their results.
This internship has a minimum twelve (12) week duration with 2027 start dates only.
## Responsibilities
• Research and develop audio-visual interactive and generative models, such as any-to-any models across speech, text, and video, real-time agentic interactive systems, and autoregressive generation.
• Improve inference speed and quality through distillation, streaming generation, and efficient architectures.
• Develop post-training methods, including fine-tuning and multimodal reinforcement learning.
• Build evaluation methods and benchmarks for long-form, multi-turn interaction and generation.
• Work with researchers and engineers to bring results into prototypes, and publish findings at peer-reviewed venues.
## Minimum Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
• Research experience in at least one of: generative models, speech-to-speech (S2S) models, or reinforcement learning
• Experience with Python and a deep learning framework such as PyTorch
## Preferred Qualifications
• First-author publications at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, or ICML
• Experience with reinforcement learning for generative models, or with LLM-based agents
• Experience training large models on distributed GPU clusters
• Experience building or post-training frontier-scale, high-quality models
• Strong interest in next-generation interactive models and agentic workflows
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
